Therefore, during this period, Fuzhou's noon solar altitude first increased and then decreased.

method.method_draft: From the text, compute the astronauts' stay as roughly June 18 to June 28, 2012. Note from the image that the relevant observable is the maximum solar altitude at local noon. For Fuzhou, take latitude about 26°N. Apply H = 90° - |φ - δ|: as the Sun's declination rises from June 18 to the summer solstice, Fuzhou's noon solar altitude rises; after the solstice declination falls, so the noon solar altitude falls. Conclude: 福州正午太阳高度先增后减。
